# WoW Raid Bot for Discord

Raid sign-ups, roster management & reminders — right in Discord

A free Discord raid bot built for WoW Classic guilds and PUG organizers. Post raids, collect sign-ups with slash commands, and send automatic reminders — your members never need to leave Discord.

[Add to Your Server](https://discord.com/oauth2/authorize?client_id=1458539192547283237&permissions=311653911552&integration_type=0&scope=bot+applications.commands)

Requires **Send Messages** , **Embed Links** , and **Use Slash Commands** permissions.

## On This Page

1. Features
2. Getting Started
3. Slash Commands
4. Sign-up Workflow
5. Guild Integration
6. Raid Announcements
7. Personal Notifications

## Features

### Live Updates

Event embeds automatically update when the roster changes — no manual refresh needed.

### Scheduled Reminders

Automatic event reminders at 24h, 2h, and 1h before start time via Discord notifications.
### Rich Roster Display

See tanks, healers, melee DPS, and ranged DPS with WoW class emojis and colors.

### Guild Integration

Map Discord roles to Raidify guild roles for automatic membership.

### What You'll Need

1

Discord Server

A server where you have "Manage Server" permission

2

Raidify Account

Sign in once at raidify.app to link your Discord

3

WoW Character

At least one character added to your Raidify profile

## Getting Started

1

### Add the Bot to Your Server

Click the "Add to Your Server" button at the top of this page. You'll be redirected to Discord where you can:

1. Select which server to add the bot to (from the dropdown)
2. Review the permissions the bot needs
3. Click **Authorize** to confirm

**Required permissions:** The bot needs "Send Messages," "Embed Links," and "Use Slash Commands" to function properly.

2

### Link Your Discord Account

Before signing up for raids, members need to link their Discord to Raidify once:

1. Visit raidify.app
3.

...

View detailed information about a specific event including full roster breakdown by role (Tanks, Healers, Melee DPS, Ranged DPS) with WoW class colors. Also shows waitlist, pending approvals, and tentative sign-ups.

Usage: `/raid <id>`

Example: `/raid abc123`

`/roster`

Display the approved roster for an event, grouped by role with spec emojis and a progress bar showing roster fill status.

Usage: `/roster <id>`

Example: `/roster abc123`

`/signup`

Sign up for an event directly from Discord. Select your character and spec from a dropdown. If you don't have a character yet, you can create one during the sign-up flow.

Usage: `/signup <raid-id>`

Example: `/signup abc123`

`/groups`

Post the group plan (party assignments) for a raid as a live-updating embed. Shows each group by role, plus waitlist, unassigned, and tentative (T) players.

Usage: `/groups <id>`

Example: `/groups abc123`

`/confirm-roster`
Post a confirmation embed asking the approved roster to confirm or decline attendance. Updates live as players respond.

Usage: `/confirm-roster <id>`

Example: `/confirm-roster abc123`

`/confirm-groups`

Post a confirmation embed for the group assignments so grouped players can confirm their spot before the raid.

Usage: `/confirm-groups <id>`

Example: `/confirm-groups abc123`

## Sign-up Workflow

Here's the typical workflow for organizing a raid using the Discord bot:

1

### Create Raid

Set up the raid on the web app with all details

→

2

### Share to Discord

Post /raid id:abc123 in your channel

→

3

### Collect Sign-ups

Members use /signup to join

→

4

### Review & Approve

Approve players on the web app

→

5

### Raid Day

Export to addon, auto-invite, raid!

**Tip:** Pin the raid embed in your channel so members can easily find it. The embed updates automatically when the roster changes!

## Guild Integration
This section is for **raid leaders and officers** who manage a guild. Raiders just sign up for raids via the bot commands.

Link your Raidify guild to your Discord server for automatic role syncing and streamlined management.

### Linking Your Guild

1. Go to your **Guild Settings** on the web app
2. In **Discord Integration** , click **Link Discord Server**
3. Select your Discord server from the dropdown
4. Configure role mappings (optional but recommended)

### Discord Role Mapping

Map your Discord roles to Raidify guild roles for automatic membership:

@Raider → Member

@Officer → Officer

@Guild Master → Officer (All Perms)

#### Guild Raids

* • Visible to all guild members
* • Appear on guild calendar
* • Managed by officers
* • Use guild's game version

#### Personal Raids

* • Created by individuals
* • Shared via link or Discord
* • Full organizer control
* • Any game version

## Raid Announcements

### Automatically post events to Discord

...

* Create a dedicated **\#event-signups** channel for event posts
* Pin active event embeds so members can find them easily
* Use a separate channel for event reminders (notifications)
* Consider a **\#event-discussion** channel for planning

### Tips for Organizers

* Set up recurring schedules to auto-create weekly events
* Use the Event Planner to organize groups and assignments
* Export the roster to the WoW addon for auto-invites
* Lock the event once the roster is finalized

## Ready to Get Started?

e once an hour, minute or raid
* You decide if points should be given out on raid start or not
* You decide if players that have not answered/put tentative on the calendar invite has their attendance point from raid start automatically revoked
* You decide which scoring algorithm you want to use

**How does the scoring algorithm work?**

The algorithm is working with dynamic weights that adjusts with each players age in the guild. There are 2 weights that are being used as variables in a complex mathematical algorithm, those are the players attendance points and their %. The weights shift depending on how many attendance points a player has. If someone has a lot of attendance points the amount of attendance points while still matter will lose weight and their % will gain weight.

...

If you are simply looking for an efficient and self maintained system you can just use it to track attendance and see that everyone is in compliance with your guild standards. For more involvement it can be used as the order players are receiving cosmetic rewards for example end-of-raid mounts. I do not promote addons having full power of loot decisions however if the upgrade of an item is equal to all parties involved and the loot council are out of objective metrics and factors; RAT can be used as a tie-breaker by checking the ranks when using the RAT-algorithm you can see who is more likely to show up to the raid.

## **About raid log function**

* **Manually add raids: _Raid Logs_ > _New Raid Log_** then select date to add. After that, you can edit attendances of that day in _**Attendance Editor**_ .
* **Manually edit attendance: _Raid Logs_ > _Attendance Editor_** .  
  To change attendance, double click the gird in second column.  
  You can also edit the reason for each absentee, or edit the join time for each attendees. Just don't forget to press **_OK_** and _**Save All Changes**_ when you're done.
* **Send raid logs data:** Select raid logs in the list, then click **_Send To Raid_** . You can use **_Ctrl_** or **_Shift_** to do multiple selection.
